description: List workbook worksheets and preview cell values from Excel or OpenDocument spreadsheets without running macros. Up to 32 MiB input, 50,000 rows and 200 columns. CSV cells remain strings unless an operation explicitly parses numeric values. No uploaded code is executed. Formula cells use cached results when present; formulas are not recalculated. Formatting is not reproduced. Queues a run and returns its ID for progress and output tracking. Uses cloud allowance.
name: sheet_view
title: View a spreadsheet
